_README: Staging fixtures for T5-1.3 live executor. Maps placeholder names from doc curl examples ($AGENT_ID, $ORG_ID, $TEAM_ID, …) to known-good values that exist in the staging environment. Populate as the T5-2 / T5-4 audits identify which examples are worth running live. Empty in v1 — most examples will skip with 'unresolved placeholder'. The executor's <name> form looks up either the upper-cased _-joined key (<your-token> → YOUR_TOKEN) or the lower-cased name.
